notes.title: 2nd Demo Update
notes.content:
The demo has had some improvements and bug fixes:

Location details now highlight the specific location.

Menu buttons no longer tremble.

Issues with pages duplicating and disappearing should be resolved. (This may require starting a new game.)

Crashes with Alt+Tab in fullscreen should no longer occur.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
There's a new update for the demo available now!

There's a new look to parts of the game.

There's a greater variety to the ambient sounds.

There is now a way to organize attached pages.

You can now use the keyboard for more things.

Middle-click / R / C: Attach pages. Repeat to rearrange attached pages.

Up / Down arrows: Look up / down.

Updated controls tutorial.

Several bugs have been fixed.
